in_hebrew.name: Gerlac
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gerlac הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Gerlac is derived from the Germanic elements ger meaning 'spear' and lac meaning 'ruler'. This name was popular among the Germanic peoples and was borne by several early Christian saints.
